name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: AI meeting bot that records, transcribes, summarizes, and searches calls

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked 2026-07-30; Pro is listed at $18/seat/month monthly and $10/seat/month annually.

verdictSummary: The summarizer is easy; the meeting bot, calendar routing, integrations, team search, and admin layer make it more than a one-prompt clone.
coreLoopDIY: Create a recorder/bot, capture call audio, transcribe, generate summaries/action items, store transcripts, and add keyword search.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the bot reliably appears, captures, files, and shares notes across the whole team.

priorArt.name: whisper.cpp
priorArt.desc: Provides the commodity transcription layer; the SaaS moat is the meeting/integration layer

notes: Useful contrast with Granola: same AI primitive, harder product surface.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Fireflies.ai (AI meeting bot that records, transcribes, summarizes, and searches calls). Requirements:

- Core loop: Create a recorder/bot, capture call audio, transcribe, generate summaries/action items, store transcripts, and add keyword search.
- Needs: speech API.
- Needs: calendar API.
- Needs: Zoom/Meet/Teams capture route.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Needs: database/search.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: native meeting bot reliability; integrations with CRM/project tools; team permissions.
